# BoredMutant and Aham, full site content

> Aham is an early-stage chat-first agent transaction network being built by BoredMutant. It is intended to connect consumer requests with participating businesses whose agents can return structured offers and coordinate bookings. The initial operational focus is Hyderabad, India.

Canonical: https://www.boredmutant.com/
Booking: https://cal.com/boredmutant/automations

## Aham

URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/

Introducing Aham

Real-world services, arranged by agents. Aham is a chat-first network in development that helps people find and book local services through centrally managed AI agents representing consumers and businesses — starting with WhatsApp, with Telegram and other messaging apps to follow. Talk about Aham How the network works Hyderabad first · Built for many service categories · Early development Illustrative request Chat → agents 01 · Requestconsumer Find a car service near Kondapur tomorrow afternoon, under ₹8,000. 02 · Discoverorchestrator Eligible business agents are asked for current availability and a structured offer. 03 · Compareconsumer approval Offers are checked against the consumer's preferences and authorization limits. Provider confirms the booking Outcome sent in chat Illustrative product flow No live bookings yet The network

Return a real offer A business agent checks its configured rules and availability, then responds with scope, price, timing and terms. Business AgentFresh availability 04 · Authorization

Approve, then confirm Deterministic policy checks decide what is allowed. The provider's confirmed result is recorded before the consumer is told it's booked. Explicit approvalAuditable state ■ Models interpret and communicate AI can clarify a request, summarize offers and draft a response. It cannot authorize spending, invent availability or confirm a booking. ↗ Software enforces rules and records actions Transaction state, user mandates, business policies and provider confirmations govern side effects. For service businesses

Make your services understandable to authorized agents. A participating business configures its services, availability, pricing rules, booking terms and escalation path. Its agent can answer within those rules and hand uncertain cases to a person. Business setup

Start with a conversation Onboarding is designed to collect a structured business profile and service catalog conversationally, with owner review before public activation. Services and areasHours and capacityPricing rulesHuman escalation Supported patterns, planned

Appointments, quotes and consultations The first transaction patterns are fixed-price appointments, quote-required services and consultations. Each category needs its own readiness checks before it is offered. DiscoverOfferAuthorizeBook or escalate Connecting a business messaging account or calendar can require a secure provider handoff or browser-based authorization; setup is not guaranteed to happen entirely in chat. Where the project stands

Building the transaction foundation first. Aham is in early development. The repository contains the initial API, worker, shared schemas and transaction rules, PostgreSQL migrations, and a deterministic local demo. Current foundation and product boundary BuiltLocal deterministic transaction demo and API foundations NextReliable asynchronous workflows and real integrations LaterVerified business onboarding and pilot bookings TodayDemo offers and bookings are mock data, not live transactions Not production-ready: the local demo uses SQLite and mock offers/bookings. PostgreSQL is the planned production source of truth. WhatsApp integration code exists, but live customer bookings, business onboarding and production integrations are still future work. Chat-firstMeet consumers in the messaging apps they already use — starting with WhatsApp, with Telegram and others to follow. Secure integration steps may still need a handoff. Real offers onlyAvailability and terms must come from the provider. Ambiguous or unsupported cases go to a person. Permission before actionUser mandates and business policies are checked in deterministic software before a transaction can proceed. Hyderabad firstThe architecture is intended to support more service categories and geographies, while the initial operational focus is Hyderabad. A careful first release

A broad foundation, a deliberately limited launch. Designed for the first release

Three reusable transaction patterns Fixed-price appointments, quote-required services, and consultations give the network a controlled starting point. General services, auto repair and home repair may be piloted only after category checks. Not an initial promise

No blanket automation or open-ended commitments Healthcare is limited to administrative appointment handling after privacy and safety review. No diagnosis, medical advice, arbitrary business outreach, customer fund custody or unapproved payment handling.

Help shape a more useful way to book local services. Aham is being built around clear offers, explicit permission and reliable provider confirmation. ## How Aham works

URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/how-it-works

**Q: Is Aham live yet?**

A: Not yet. Aham is in early development in Hyderabad, and the flows shown on this site are illustrative. If you're a consumer or a service business who wants to shape the pilot, talk to us.

**Q: Do businesses need to install an app or change how they work?**

A: No. Businesses participate through their existing messaging presence (starting with WhatsApp) plus a structured profile: services, areas, hours, pricing rules and an escalation path. Onboarding starts as a conversation, and the owner reviews everything before activation.

**Q: Who handles payment?**

A: You do, directly with the provider, on terms you approved. Aham coordinates discovery, offers and booking state — it never holds your money or pays on your behalf.

**Q: Can the agent book something I didn't approve?**

A: No. Deterministic software checks your preferences and spending mandates before anything can proceed, and a booking is only reported as confirmed after the provider confirms it through their own booking path.

**Q: Why Hyderabad first?**

A: Starting in one city lets us get the transaction patterns right with real businesses before expanding. The architecture is designed to support more categories and geographies after validation.

Home / How it works

From a chat message to a confirmed booking. Aham coordinates five steps between your request and a provider-confirmed booking. You see a familiar chat; the network enforces the rules underneath. The booking flow

Five steps. One approval that matters: yours. 01 · You

Describe the job Tell Aham what you need in your messaging app — the service, area, timing and budget. Your consumer agent asks for anything essential that's missing. Messaging appConsumer agent 02 · Orchestrator

Find eligible businesses The orchestrator routes a structured request to participating businesses with a matching service and location — no broadcast spam, no cold calls. Business registryStructured request 03 · Businesses

Return real offers Each business agent checks its configured rules and live availability, then responds with scope, price, timing and terms. Nothing is invented. Business agentLive availability 04 · You

Compare and approve Offers arrive side by side in chat. You compare and approve one — deterministic checks run against your preferences and spending mandates first. Explicit approvalYour mandate 05 · Provider

Booking confirmed The provider confirms through their own authoritative booking path. Only then is the booking recorded and reported to you as confirmed. Provider-confirmedRecorded ■ Models interpret and communicate AI clarifies requests, summarizes offers and drafts messages. It cannot authorize spending, invent availability, or confirm a booking. ↗ Software enforces rules and records actions Transaction state, your mandates, business policies and provider confirmations govern every side effect — in deterministic code, not in a model's judgment. What you can book

Three transaction patterns to start. Aham launches with a deliberately limited set of booking patterns. Each one has its own readiness checks before it is offered. Pattern 01

Fixed-price appointments Services with a published price and a calendar: salons, clinics, classes. Pick a slot, approve the price, get a confirmed booking. Pattern 02

Quote-required services Repairs, renovations, custom work. Businesses return structured quotes with scope, price, timing and expiry — you compare and approve one. Pattern 03

Consultations Advice-first services: legal, financial, technical. Book time with a professional on stated terms, confirmed by the provider. Not in scope

What Aham won't do No holding your money, no payments on your behalf, no diagnosis or medical advice, no outreach to businesses that haven't joined the network. Questions

Asked often.

See a booking arranged the careful way. Clear offers, explicit approval, provider-confirmed bookings — starting in Hyderabad. Talk about Aham A BoredMutant project · Hyderabad first · Early development

## About BoredMutant

URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/about

Home / About

BoredMutant is building Aham. BoredMutant is a technology company registered in India. We are building Aham — a chat-first agent transaction network that meets people in the messaging apps they already use — starting with WhatsApp, with Telegram and others to follow — and helps them discover local services, compare structured offers from businesses, and book appointments with explicit approval. Starting in Hyderabad. Why this exists

Booking a local service shouldn't be a research project. Finding a trustworthy electrician, comparing quotes for a repair, or booking a clinic slot in India today means switching between search results, WhatsApp chats, phone calls and guesswork. Meanwhile, the actual negotiation already happens on WhatsApp — it's where India does business. Aham meets people where they are: describe what you need in a chat, and let software do the legwork — finding eligible businesses, collecting structured offers, and recording a provider-confirmed booking. The people decide; the agents do the work. How we work

One team, built in the open about its stage. Team

Solo founder, Hyderabad BoredMutant is founded and run by a solo engineer in Hyderabad, working full-time on Aham alongside deep experience building AI systems and automation. Small team, short feedback loops, no theatre. Stage

In development, honestly Aham is not live yet. The transaction foundations — request routing, offer structuring, authorization rules — are being built and tested locally before any real booking touches the network. This site says what's real today. Principle

Permission before action Nothing books, charges or commits without explicit approval. Models interpret and communicate; deterministic software enforces the rules and records what happened. Principle

Real offers only Availability, pricing and terms come from the provider — never invented. Ambiguous or unsupported cases go to a person, not through a workaround. Contact
